label: minimax-router-fusion-candidate-repair-negative-20260520
purpose: evaluate whether the existing exact MiniMax candidate-repair router kernel is viable as an all-expert router-linear fusion primitive

decision.reason: standalone exactness is good, but the all-256 candidate-repair kernel is much slower than the current router linear

next_steps: measure full-model decode timing to see whether router materialization is still visible
